company.name: Aura
company.shortDescription: Aura provides AI-powered security solutions that offer identity theft protection, credit monitoring, and online privacy for individuals.
company.description: Aura is an information technology company dedicated to creating a safer internet for everyone. People are doing more online than ever, but as our lives get more connected, it's hard to know what’s safe. Aura believes people should be able to live their digital lives with peace of mind. Its mission is to create a safer internet by making comprehensive digital security simple to understand and easy to use so everyone can stay safe online.

productsAndServices.description: Subscription-based digital protection for individuals and families covering identity theft, financial fraud, privacy, online threats, devices, and family safety across supported devices.
productsAndServices.name: Aura Digital Safety Plans

productsAndServices.description: Helps remove personal information from data brokers, people-search websites, and certain online search results to reduce unwanted exposure.

productsAndServices.description: Monitors linked banking and retirement accounts for unusual transactions and alerts members to activity that differs from expected spending patterns or locations.
productsAndServices.name: Suspicious Transaction Alerts

productsAndServices.description: Encrypts internet connections, helps protect users on public or private networks, blocks known scam and phishing sites, and provides more than 100 virtual locations.
